connector.name: Createya - AI Image & Video Generation
connector.registryDescription: 100+ AI models: FLUX, Sora, Veo, Kling, Runway, Suno. OAuth or Bearer. No VPN. RU billing.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.createya.ai over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the createya-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
